Speaking on her podcast, Keeping It Real , on Friday, Michaels cited research from Pew that said 28 percent of voters identify as Republicans, 29 percent as Democrats, and 44 percent as independent, or something else. Among independents, 43 percent lean Republican and 47 percent lean Democrat. The support can come in two parts, daily living and mobility, with the former based on whether you're able to do a range of household tasks like washing and cooking, and the latter based on your mobility and travel requirements. It's available to people 16 and over and under State Pension age. You'll continue getting it beyond that point if you have an approved claim, but you generally can't make a new claim after reaching State Pension age. During an interview with The Hollywood Reporter back in August, it was pointed out that season four would mark Monster’s first time dealing with a figure who had been acquitted of the crimes which they’d been accused of. Asked whether this made the creative team hesitate before taking on the Lizzie Borden case, Ryan responded: “I find [Monster] to be very interesting because you know that no matter what you do, it’s going to be controversial.
